title: Sunnyside Retail pilot — customer call notes & integration scratchpad
content:
Meeting: 2025-09-12 initial kickoff (follow-up 2025-09-26)
Attendees: Priya (RWD), Ethan (RWD), Marco (RWD), Zoe Park (Sunnyside Eng), Omar Diaz (Sunnyside PM), Legal: TBC

Purpose:
- Capture integration requirements and immediate technical risks for Sunnyside Retail pilot (product recommendations + in-store assistant prototype).
- Determine minimal config for a Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private recommendation for MVP.

High-level customer ask:
- Real-time product lookup + contextual suggestions for in-store associates (mobile app).
- Short latencies (target p50 <200ms, p95 <600ms) for single-turn queries.
- Embeddings for semantic search across product catalog and FAQs.
- Data residency: US-only. No PII storage in hosted logs (they will want KMS + audit log assurances).
- Pilot scale: 50 sustained req/s during store hours, spikes to 300 req/s planned for Black Friday test. Token profiles: avg request 120 tokens in, 120 tokens out.

Initial architecture options discussed:
- Hosted API (fastest): quick onboarding, Redwood retains model infra; drawback: customer wants tighter audit controls and KMS integration for keys in transit.
- Dedicated: sounds like likely path for production pilot (predictable throughput, can tie to dedicated pools).
- Private (VPC): longer runway, but required only if legal requires full control. Keep as fallback.

Tech requirements & constraints (customer-stated):
- SSO (Okta) for admin console access.
- Connectors to their product catalog (ElasticSearch) and Snowflake for nightly sync.
- Must run inference only on US regions.
- Compliance: SOC2 required before production; they want log retention 1 year with redaction for PII.

Integration gotchas (notes to self):
- Embeddings: they want 768-d vectors, but their ES index currently expects 512-d. Need to propose either reindex or on-the-fly dimension reduction (we should avoid, propose reindex).
- Catalog augmentation: product descriptions contain HTML — ensure we provide cleaning pipeline and token budget estimates.
- Mobile app calls come from client devices; avoid exposing API keys in client. Recommend proxy through their backend (standard).
- CORS + caching: have them set up a gateway to reduce token-level costs and centralize rate limiting.
- Cache invalidation: catalog updates can be frequent; recommend prefix caching with 5m TTL + webhook invalidation from their CMS.
- Tokenization mismatch: their existing prompt templates assume whitespace tokenization; test on our tokenizer to avoid surprises (estimate +10% tokens).

Performance / cost estimates (MVP):
- 50 req/s * 240 tokens total request -> ~12k tokens/s -> 432M tokens/hour peak; this is large but acceptable for Dedicated pool. Need formal capacity calc with infra team.
- Suggest model: redwood-llama2-13B-quant (verified perf). Provide fallback to a smaller low-latency variant for p95 breach.

Security & compliance notes:
- Customer requires KMS integration — confirm supported KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and whether Hosted can use customer-managed keys.
- They asked about HSM / FIPS mode for key storage — escalate to security for definitive answer.
- Audit logs: they need exportable logs to their SIEM (Splunk). Confirm log schema and retention policy.

Prototype UX constraints:
- UI will show suggested answers + source citations (must return doc IDs and offsets). Ensure we include retriever metadata in responses and stable doc IDs.
- They want 1-click escalate to human. Plan: include trace id in response so their ticket system can fetch context.

Sample prompt examples (rough):
- "Given the product with SKU {sku}, summarize top 3 selling points for store associate to communicate in 1–2 sentences."
- "Customer says: 'My jacket smells of mildew after rain' — recommend cleaning instructions and product recommendations (2 items)."

Open questions / follow-ups for Sunnyside:
1) Legal: what PII categories must we purge from logs (phone number, email, loyalty ID)? (ACTION: Zoe to confirm by 2025-09-19)
2) Which KMS provider will Sunnyside use? (ACTION: Omar to confirm by 2025-09-22)
3) Do they want embeddings reindex handled by Redwood or their infra? (ACTION: Priya to propose 2 options by 2025-09-19)
4) Black Friday spike plan: do they want us to pre-warm pools? (ACTION: Marco to draft pre-warm runbook)

Immediate action items (who/when):
- Priya: Draft Hosted vs Dedicated pros/cons + estimated cost delta for pilot (due 2025-09-16).
- Ethan: Run quick tokenizer pass on 500 representative catalog entries to estimate token multiplier (due 2025-09-15).
- Marco: Check Dedicated pool sizing with infra and give recommendation for 50->300 req/s (due 2025-09-18).
- Anika: Open Jira RED-4310 for embeddings reindex and attach sample mapping (done 2025-09-13).
- Zoe (Sunnyside): Confirm PII list and Okta SSO details (due 2025-09-19).

Notes for demo build (MVP scope):
- Feature set: lookup by text, SKU lookup, small FAQ assistant, context window for last 3 interactions per session.
- Persistence: short session history (5 min TTL) stored in their backend; do not store raw user utterances in hosted logs (per legal ask).
- Retries: implement exponential backoff and fallback model on 429/503.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: Token explosion from long product descriptions -> Mitigate: add pre-flight summarizer step to compress descriptions and store compressed summaries in embeddings index.
- Risk: Data residency breach -> Mitigate: enforce region routing policy, confirm infra team enforces US-only nodes for this tenant.
- Risk: Unexpected cost during BF spike -> Mitigate: quota + alerting + auto-fallback to cheaper model.

Next meeting: 2025-09-26 13:00 PT (internal prep 30m) — agenda: present Hosted vs Dedicated recommendation, show tokenizer numbers, confirm PII and KMS answers.

Quick links (to share in follow-up email):
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SUN/Project+Overview
- Jira: RED-4218 (pilot requirements), RED-4310 (embeddings reindex)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sunnyside-integ/pull/7 (data sync sketch)

Notes-to-self: keep this doc minimal and move finalized items to Confluence after decision on infra. Capture sample telemetry: p50/p95 per route, tokens-per-request distribution, cache hit rate.

-- Priya
